content:
Overview

Kazanlak is a city in Stara Zagora with a population of 48,000. The capital of the Rose Valley, famous for its rose oil production, the UNESCO-listed Thracian Tomb of Kazanlak, and the annual Rose Festival. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
